# Live ASR: what a block costs and whether the queue drains

Repo: ambient.
Writes: docs/developing/measurements.md

## Outcome

Measure the per-block cost of live transcription and record the verdict.

## Acceptance

`scripts/check` prints `CHECK OK` as its last line.

1. `cargo test bench::` passes with exactly 8 tests.
2. `cargo run --release --bin asrbench` exits 0 and prints an `rtf=` line.

## Non-goals

- No CLI surface beyond the bench binaries.

## Context

The measurements doc is the reader of record.
